channel.title: Volatility Lab — Experiments & Notes
channel.description: New research notes and reproducible machine-learning experiments on cryptocurrency volatility.

item.title: Experiment 01 — Forecasting 24-hour Realized Volatility
item.description: A comparison of HAR benchmarks, additional market features, and regression models for forecasting realized volatility. The study combines five RV estimators and examines RMSE and QLIKE.
